mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 46 degrees and a first quarter moon. You can also catch the International Space Station early today starting at 4:57 AM, as it rises over Mount Horeb and travels high overhead toward the Fitchburg and Madison area.

The city has two main updates today. First, you can now apply for a stormwater utility credit if you help protect our local systems by installing rain gardens or rain barrels. Additionally, the police department recently handled an incident involving a school bus driver who was arrested for O W I on October 15 after reports of dangerous driving behavior; fortunately, no injuries were reported.

There is plenty to do around town. Today you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the fun continues with trivia at Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory, along with live music and yoga sessions available throughout the week.
Regarding the incident on October 15, Verona police arrested a school bus driver for O W I following reports of erratic driving while students were being transported near Whalen Road.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Devil's Food Cake. The store is currently closed for the morning but will open today at 10:00 AM.
